protocol.title: A Microfluidic Device for Measuring Cell Migration Towards Substrate-Bound and Soluble Chemokine Gradients
protocol.platform: Two-layer PDMS microfluidic device with LAPAP photo-patterning and flow-free diffusion gradient generation
protocol.cell_type: Bone marrow-derived dendritic cells (DCs) from C57BL/6J mice
protocol.objective: Simultaneous generation of surface-immobilized haptotactic (CCL21) and diffusion-based chemotactic (CCL19) chemokine gradients; single-cell tracking of DC migration in combined and competing gradient fields

layers: PDMS flow layer: 6 migration chambers (l=1100 um, w=200 um, h_max=28 um)
PDMS control layer: independently controllable membrane valves on all ports
Glass substrate: fibronectin-coated (250 ug/mL) for beta2-integrin-mediated DC adhesion

migration_chambers.side_port: one, at midpoint of long axis
migration_chambers.short_end_ports: two; connected to source and sink support channels

device.valves: Independently controllable PDMS membrane valves on all ports; optimal closing pressure determined per chip by incrementing control channel pressure in 0.5 bar steps
device.coating: Human plasma fibronectin, c=250 ug/mL (Millipore, Austria); 1 h incubation; acts as beta2-integrin ligand for DC adhesion and 2D migration

reagents.streptavidin: Streptavidin-Cy3 (SA-Cy3), 10 ug/mL in PBS with 3% BSA (Sigma Aldrich, US)

immobilized_chemokine.name: CCL21 24-98 bio
immobilized_chemokine.truncation_rationale: Removes basic C-terminal extension of full-length CCL21 (aa 1-134) which causes unspecific background binding via heparan sulfate

soluble_chemokine.name: CCL19
soluble_chemokine.gradient_tracer: FITC-dextran 10 kDa (200 ug/mL; Sigma Aldrich, US; hydrodynamic radius 2.3 nm)

gradient_tracer.name: FITC-dextran 10 kDa
gradient_tracer.purpose: Proxy tracer for chemokine diffusion profile; similar hydrodynamic radius to CCL19 (1.7+/-0.4 nm) and CCL21 (1.9+/-0.4 nm)

reagents.cell_culture_medium: RPMI 1640 (R10) + 10% fetal calf serum + L-Glucose + Penicillin/Streptomycin (Life Sciences, Austria)

lapap_system.objective: Zeiss LD Plan Neo 20x/0.4, long working distance
lapap_system.mirror_system: High-speed galvanometric mirror pair for focus spot scanning
lapap_system.pattern_specification: Image file; pixel intensity values determine local light dose
lapap_system.calibration: Compensates for off-center NA drop and geometric distortions from scan mirrors into objective back aperture; total light dose split into multiple pulses per spot to average pulse-to-pulse power variability

gradient_generation.reference: Frank & Tay, Lab Chip 13, 1273 (2013); Mehling et al., Lab Chip 15, 1276 (2015)
gradient_generation.source_channel: Sequentially refilled with R10 + CCL19 (2.5 ug/mL) + FITC-dextran 10 kDa (200 ug/mL)
gradient_generation.sink_channel: Sequentially refilled with fresh R10 medium
gradient_generation.gradient_profiles: Monitored by FITC-dextran fluorescence; spatially averaged over centered longitudinal section of chamber (Fig. 1d)

imaging.image_processing: Fiji (Schindelin et al., Nat Meth 9, 2012) + Manual Tracking plugin (Cordelieres 2005)

statistical_analysis.directionality_metric: <cos(Theta)>; Theta = angle between gradient direction and current cell direction

steps.name: Chip priming with PBS
steps.notes: Flow lines pressurised; entire chip filled with PBS. Control channel pressure incremented in 0.5 bar steps to determine optimal valve closing pressure per chip.

steps.name: Fibronectin coating of migration chambers
steps.notes: Fibronectin incubated 1 h in cell culture chambers. After coating, fibronectin in flow channels flushed with PBS (60 s). Chambers then flushed with R10 medium 10 min.

steps.name: LAPAP - B4F loading and PBS wash
steps.notes: Chambers washed with PBS 10 s to remove unbound fibronectin. B4F (150 ug/mL) loaded into assembled closed channels via reagent inlets and coats glass surface prior to UV patterning.

steps.name: LAPAP - UV laser gradient writing
steps.operation: mix (abstracts laser scanning event over B4F-coated chamber)
steps.notes: Gradient written one spot at a time; spot spacing ~half focus diameter for continuous pattern. Pixel intensity image specifies local light dose. Unbound B4F washed out with PBS (10 s) after writing.

steps.name: Streptavidin-Cy3 incubation
steps.notes: SA-Cy3 binds to photobleached B4F anchors in laser-written pattern. SA-Cy3 fluorescence allows visualization and quantification of printed gradient. Followed by PBS wash (10 s).

steps.name: CCL21 24-98 bio immobilization
steps.notes: Biotin tag on CCL21 C-terminus binds streptavidin anchors. Truncated aa 24-98 prevents heparan-sulfate unspecific binding. Supporting channels kept under constant PBS flow (0.2 bar) during loading. Followed by PBS wash (10 s).

steps.name: DC loading into migration chambers
steps.loading_port: short-end ports (produces distribution along chamber length)
steps.dc_source: C57BL/6J mouse bone marrow; GM-CSF culture day 8-10; LPS maturation overnight (200 ng/mL)
steps.notes: DCs adhere loosely to fibronectin-coated PDMS. Round morphology with constant protrusions under control conditions. 30 min adhesion recovery before gradient initiation.

steps.name: Haptotaxis detection - DC migration on immobilized CCL21 gradient

expected_results.CCL21_patch_uniform: Haptokinesis: increased migration speed, no directed migration; isotropic rose plot
expected_results.CCL21_gradient: Haptotaxis: directed migration toward high CCL21; asymmetric rose plot toward gradient direction

steps.name: DC loading for CCL19 chemotaxis arm
steps.notes: Fresh DCs loaded into fibronectin-coated chambers without CCL21 patterning. 30 min adhesion recovery.

steps.name: CCL19 soluble gradient generation
steps.notes: FITC-dextran traces gradient profile. Control: R10 from both ends (undirected migration, Fig. 4a).

steps.name: Chemotaxis detection - DC migration in CCL19 soluble gradient
steps.directionality_analysis: Directionality plotted vs. chamber position (= local CCL19 concentration) and time; Fig. 4e

steps.name: LAPAP re-patterning and DC loading for competing gradient arm
steps.operation: mix (sequential: B4F load, laser write, SA-Cy3, CCL21 immobilization, DC loading)
steps.ccl21_gradient_region: lower and middle area of migration chamber
steps.notes: Full LAPAP patterning protocol repeated for competing gradient experiment. DCs positioned to include both CCL21-gradient regions. 30 min recovery before CCL19 gradient generation.

steps.name: Opposing CCL19 soluble gradient superimposition

conditionA.label: CCL19_low / CCL21
conditionA.expected_outcome: DC migration toward haptotactic CCL21 gradient (haptotaxis dominant at all time points; Fig. 5a)

conditionB.label: CCL19_medium / CCL21
conditionB.expected_outcome: DC migration overrides toward chemotactic CCL19 after gradient build-up (chemotaxis dominant; Fig. 5b)

steps.gradient_direction: Opposing: CCL19 source at one short end; CCL21 gradient in lower/middle chamber area pointing opposite direction
steps.imaging: SA-Cy3 (CCL21, red) and FITC-dextran (CCL19, green) fluorescence channels imaged simultaneously
steps.notes: Both conditions run in parallel in separate CCL21-gradient regions of the same chip. Directionality measured as <cos(Theta)> vs. position and time (Fig. 5c). CCL19 can override immobilized CCL21 signal above ~1 ug/mL threshold.

steps.name: Competing gradient detection and directionality resolution

basic_blocks.label: main
basic_blocks.content: Device priming, fibronectin coating, LAPAP B4F loading, UV laser patterning, SA-Cy3 incubation, CCL21 immobilization, DC loading, haptotaxis detection

basic_blocks.label: bsbbif_4_j
basic_blocks.content: dispose(haptotaxisSignal); DC loading for chemotaxis arm; CCL19 gradient generation; chemotaxis detection

basic_blocks.label: bsbbif_7_j
basic_blocks.content: dispose(chemotaxisSignal); LAPAP re-patterning; DC loading; opposing CCL19 gradient generation (conditions A and B); competing gradient detection

bioscript_compiler_notes.ir_output: 10 basic blocks (BB1-BB10), 3 if/else gates, 12 CFG edges
bioscript_compiler_notes.duration_units: s and m only (BioScript constraint); all durations verified against IR SECOND values

bs_abstraction_notes.lapap_laser_writing: Abstracted as mix(b4fCoated, PBS); no reagent mixing in DMF sense; represents laser scanning event over B4F surface
bs_abstraction_notes.channel_flow: All source-sink flow-switching and valve actuation steps abstracted via mix operations
bs_abstraction_notes.heat_statements: Model temperature-controlled incubations (37 C for CCL21 loading; 37 C for DC adhesion in competing arm)
bs_abstraction_notes.drain_vs_dispose_in_ir: Compiler normalises drain to dispose in IR; both are terminal fluid operations at IR level. Source .bs correctly uses drain for false branches.
bs_abstraction_notes.bb2_fallthrough: BB2 (true branch) has no explicit jump in IR; compiler handles fall-through to BB4 implicitly. Correct CFG behaviour.
